runtime.scope: All seven candidate packets together in isolated production controller; full-period sampled decoded triangle meshes, not continuous bounds

sourceContactReview.scope: Source-solid distances at candidate static phase for pre-existing triangle-contact witnesses. Near-zero distance is not positive running clearance; triangle surface intersection does not establish positive solid penetration.

rejectedIntermediateEvidence.reason: Preliminary Boolean slab clipping lost two direct whole-body shaft/bushing overlaps. All 154 affected enclosing/radial exclusions were discarded and recomputed without clipped source solids. This rejected intermediate is optional for reproduction.

retainedFitPairs.interpretation: Invariant relative pose under conditional coupling; any recorded source overlap remains a fit limitation

inheritedMeshEvidence.frontMeshes: Unchanged original geometry, display phases and ratios; prior full-material-period source polygons and selected solids retained
inheritedMeshEvidence.reverseMeshes: Equivalent relative phase invariants transfer prior complete polygon covers to the simultaneous candidate packets; 45 nm rear-hour sampled original-solid margin remains unqualified

limitations: All drive after center remains conditional on intended sticking at the two fitted interfaces
Continuous enclosing bounds apply only to the nominal qualified solids and recorded source precision; empty Boolean intersection is not a measured positive clearance
Neighbor sweeps with no positive bound are sampled, not swept-solid certification
Existing source overlaps and invalid/non-solid leaves are not mechanically accepted; not every overlap is a confirmed intended fit
Pre-existing runtime triangle contacts remain explicit; surface intersection alone does not establish positive-volume penetration
The rear hour mesh 45 nm source margin remains insufficient for a tolerance-qualified claim
Source and all authored fitted hand poses are checked separately as fixed obstacles; mutually exclusive hand variants are not asserted to coexist
No physical contact force, torque, setting, winding or self-sustaining model
No app test suite, build or browser automation rerun; unchanged lifecycle retains prior evidence
